title: WHY ELEPHANTS NEED DUST AND WATER BATHS
caption: Why African elephants use dust and water to care for their skin. 🐘 #AfricanElephant #Wildlife #AnimalBehavior #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Why do African elephants need both dusty ground and water to stay comfortable?
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic African elephant herd walking on a dry riverbed. Do not claim a visible dust cloud, mud bath or same continuous herd event.

narration_timeline.text: Under the hot African sun, their enormous bodies need ways to shed heat.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic elephant crossing a hot African landscape.

narration_timeline.text: At a waterhole, elephants wade in, splash, and let water cool their skin.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic elephants in water, wading and splashing; no invented trunk spraying.

narration_timeline.text: That water helps remove heat, while dust and mud can also protect sensitive skin.
narration_timeline.scene: Elephants visibly bathing; dust and mud protective roles are explained, not fabricated visually.

narration_timeline.text: And when a herd gathers at the same waterhole, cooling down becomes a shared routine.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual elephant herd at a waterhole, not represented as a single continuous event.

narration_timeline.text: So this isn't just a messy bath. For elephants, it's a way to care for their skin and stay comfortable.
narration_timeline.scene: Distinct real elephants bathing and moving in natural surroundings.
